# Module 1: Quantum Fundamentals & Environment Setup

Quantum computing does not replace classical computing; it extends it with a fundamentally different model of information. This module contrasts the classical bit with the qubit, motivates why certain problems are hard for classical machines, and gets your working environment stood up so that every later module runs against real tooling. By the end of the week you will have an IBMid, a working Qiskit install, and a mental model for what a qubit actually is.

Start with [Schedule.ipynb](Schedule.ipynb) -- it is the entry point for this module and links
everything below in the order you should work through it.

## Folder Layout

| Folder | Contents |
|--------|----------|
| `labs/` | Walk-through notebooks. Read and run these; they are not graded. |
| `practices/` | Ungraded hands-on notebooks with answers provided in `answers/`. |
| `exercises/` | Graded assignments. Commit and push your completed work. |
| `answers/` | Answer keys for the practices and exercises that have them. |
| `resources/` | Slide decks, PDFs, and reference material. |
| `images/` | Figures used by the notebooks in this module. |
